en_title: Artemis Fowl Animated TV Show Greenlit With Eoin Colfer as Executive Producer
cn_title: 《阿特米斯奇幻历险》获批改编动画
subtitle: 精灵世界再登荧屏
opus_summary: 迪士尼批准制作《阿特米斯奇幻历险》动画剧集，原作者将担任执行制片人。新剧讲述十三岁天才少年捕捉精灵、夺取魔法以救治母亲并拯救家庭的故事，播出日期尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: Artemis Fowl is coming back to TV screens in the form of an animated show on Disney Channel and Disney+.
paragraphs.cn: 《阿特米斯奇幻历险》将以动画剧集的形式重返荧屏，在迪士尼频道和Disney+播出。

paragraphs.en: Author Eoin Colfer announced that Disney had greenlit another series project based on his family fantasy novels at the 25 Years of Artemis Fowl panel at New York Comic Con 2026. He'll remain involved in the animated show as an executive producer, too, with Disney promising that he'll bring "his creative vision to dig deeper into the characters and lore of the beloved book series that is celebrating its 25th anniversary of the first book this year."
paragraphs.cn: 在2026年纽约漫展的《阿特米斯奇幻历险》25周年专题活动上，作家Eoin Colfer宣布，迪士尼已批准另一个改编自他所著合家欢奇幻小说的剧集项目。他也将担任执行制片人，继续参与这部动画剧集。迪士尼承诺，他将「以自己的创作理念，更深入地挖掘这套深受读者喜爱的小说中的角色与世界观；今年恰逢系列首部小说出版25周年」。

paragraphs.en: Joining Colfer in the executive producing category is Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur's Ben Juwono, as well as DuckTales' Colleen Evanson. In a statement, the Artemis Fowl author said he is "proud and delighted to be part of the formidable team that is putting the Artemis Fowl animation on screen."
paragraphs.cn: 与Colfer共同担任执行制片人的，还有漫威动画《月亮女孩与恶魔恐龙》的Ben Juwono，以及《新唐老鸭俱乐部》的Colleen Evanson。这位《阿特米斯奇幻历险》原作者在声明中表示，他「很自豪，也很高兴能加入这支强大的团队，一起将《阿特米斯奇幻历险》动画搬上荧屏」。

paragraphs.en: "Everyone is so talented and so positive that I feel certain the fairy world is in excellent hands," he added.
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「每个人都才华横溢、积极向上，让我确信精灵世界交给他们再合适不过了。」

paragraphs.en: The Artemis Fowl animated series has no release date, but when it does eventually arrive, it won't be the first swing at the property to land on Disney+. In 2020, Disney launched a live-action movie with the same name , though it largely failed to leave a good impression on fans or critics. As recorded by review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes , the straight-to-streaming film only whipped up a "rotten" 8% from critics and 19% from audiences.
paragraphs.cn: 《阿特米斯奇幻历险》动画剧集尚未公布播出日期，但等到它上线时，它并不会是Disney+上首部改编自该系列的作品。2020年，迪士尼推出过一部同名真人电影，但粉丝和影评人大多对它评价不佳。影评汇总网站烂番茄的数据显示，这部直接上线流媒体的电影新鲜度仅为8%，被评为「烂」，观众评分也只有19%。

paragraphs.en: The Artemis Fowl movie starred Ferdia Shaw as its title character and also featured appearances from Lara McDonnell, Josh Gadd, and Michael Rouse. IGN called it "an empty science fantasy tale with forgettable characters and an uninspired story" in our 4/10 review . In other words, a crack at a film didn't quite pan out, but where the 2020 project failed, the new animated show hopes to succeed.
paragraphs.cn: 《阿特米斯奇幻历险》电影由Ferdia Shaw饰演片名中的主角，Lara McDonnell、Josh Gadd和迈克尔Rouse也参演了该片。IGN在4分（满分10分）的评测中称其为「一个空洞的科学奇幻故事，角色过目即忘，剧情毫无新意」。换句话说，电影改编的尝试并不成功，而新动画剧集希望能在2020年电影失利的地方取得成功。

paragraphs.en: "The action-adventure fantasy series Artemis Fowl follows 13-year-old genius Artemis Fowl as he uncovers an underground world of armed and dangerous — and surprisingly high-tech — fairies as he launches a plan to capture one and steal its magic to heal his dying mom and save his family," a description said.
paragraphs.cn: 剧集简介写道：「动作冒险奇幻剧集《阿特米斯奇幻历险》围绕13岁的天才少年阿特米斯·法尔展开。他发现了一个地下世界，里面的精灵全副武装、十分危险，而且拥有出人意料的高科技。他展开计划，打算捕捉一只精灵并夺取其魔法，以救治奄奄一息的母亲，拯救自己的家庭。」

paragraphs.en: The original Artemis Fowl book was published in 2001, with the rest of Colfen's stories in the universe boasting more than 35 million copies sold across the globe. Elsewhere at NYCC 2026, we got another solid look at both Godzilla Minus Zero and Blade Runner 2099 . More Naruto was confirmed to be on the way , too.
paragraphs.cn: 《阿特米斯奇幻历险》首部小说于2001年出版，Colfer在这一世界观下创作的其他故事在全球的销量超过3,500万册。2026年纽约漫展还进一步展示了《哥斯拉Minus Zero》和《银翼杀手2099》，并确认《火影忍者》将有更多新内容推出。
